# Auth Me 在 Minecraft 中完成账户验证并重新认证你的会话 [![构建状态](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/axieum/authme/release.yml?branch=main&style=for-the-badge)][ci:release] [![发布版本](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/axieum/authme?style=for-the-badge&include_prereleases&sort=semver)][releases] [![支持平台](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/Available%20For_356643_latest.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge] [![下载量](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/full_356643_downloads.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge:files]
Auth Me 是一款 **Minecraft 模组**，将账户认证功能整合进游戏内，旨在解决连接服务器时臭名昭著的会话验证错误问题。 这是一款**仅限客户端**的模组，适用于 [Minecraft][minecraft] Java Edition 的现代版本。 #### 其他选择 - [ReAuth][reauth_mod] by TechnicianLP - [OAuth][oauth_mod] by Sintinium ## 赞助者 我们要特别感谢以下赞助者对 Auth Me 开发的支持。 [][bisecthosting] ## 参与贡献 感谢您考虑为 Auth Me 做贡献！请参阅[贡献指南][contributing]。 ## 安全漏洞 关于如何报告安全漏洞，请查阅[安全策略][security]。 ## 许可证 Auth Me 是根据 [MIT 许可证][licence] 开源的软件。 [bisecthosting]: https://bisecthosting.com/axieum [ci:release]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/actions/workflows/release.yml [contributing]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md [curseforge]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me [curseforge:files]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me/files [fabric]: https://fabricmc.net/ [licence]: https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT [minecraft]: https://minecraft.net/ [oauth_mod]: https://github.com/Sintinium/oauth [reauth_mod]: https://github.com/TechnicianLP/ReAuth [releases]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/releases [security]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/security/policy
